question: Which country has unveiled breakthrough gene therapy projects to treat autism and rare brain disorders in children?
solution:
**The correct answer is __United Arab Emirates (UAE).__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• The **United Arab Emirates (UAE)** unveiled two pioneering gene therapy projects to treat autism and rare neurological disorders in children.
 
• The initiatives were announced by **Emirates Health Services (EHS)** in February 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights__** 

 
• Focus on **monogenic autism** and rare neurodegenerative disorders.
 
• Includes treatment for conditions like **Beta-Propeller Protein-Associated Neurodegeneration (BPAN)**.
 
• Uses enhanced gene delivery systems targeting specific brain cells.
 
• Developed in collaboration with the **Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia**.
 
• Incorporates **Artificial Intelligence** and data from the **Emirati Genome Programme** for early diagnosis and risk identification.
